title: SEC1: test guard inconsistency and no CI hook
description: test.c: include guard (line 478) uses 2 conditions (WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV && WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_TEST) while declaration and call (lines 1073-1075, 3325-3330) use 3 (adds WOLF_CRYPTO_CB). If WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV + WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_TEST are set without WOLF_CRYPTO_CB the header is included but the test is not wired. Also: WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_TEST is not set by any configure.ac option so TLS integration tests never run in CI.
